  -- So 2^n ≡ 1 (mod 7) iff n ≡ 0 (mod 3), i.e., 3 divides n

  · -- Forward direction: if 7 | 2^n - 1, then 3 | n
    intro h
    have h₁ : 2 ^ n % 7 = 1 := by
      have h₂ : 7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 := h
      have h₃ : 2 ^ n ≥ 1 := by
        apply Nat.one_le_pow
        omega
      have h₄ : (2 ^ n - 1) % 7 = 0 := Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd h₂
      have h₅ : 2 ^ n % 7 = 1 := by
        omega
      exact h₅
    -- Use the fact that 2^n mod 7 = 1 iff n is divisible by 3
    have h₂ : n % 3 = 0 := by
      have h₃ : ∀ k : ℕ, 2 ^ (3 * k) % 7 = 1 := by
        intro k
        induction k with
        | zero => simp
        | succ k ih =>
          rw [Nat.mul_succ]
          simp [pow_add, pow_mul, Nat.pow_mod, ih]
          <;> norm_num
      have h₄ : ∀ k : ℕ, 2 ^ (3 * k + 1) % 7 = 2 := by
        intro k
        induction k with
        | zero => simp
        | succ k ih =>
          rw [Nat.mul_succ]
          simp [pow_add, pow_mul, Nat.pow_mod, ih]
          <;> norm_num
      have h₅ : ∀ k : ℕ, 2 ^ (3 * k + 2) % 7 = 4 := by
        intro k
        induction k with
        | zero => simp
        | succ k ih =>
          rw [Nat.mul_succ]
          simp [pow_add, pow_mul, Nat.pow_mod, ih]
          <;> norm_num
      have h₆ : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by omega
      rcases h₆ with (h₆ | h₆ | h₆)
      · exact h₆
      · exfalso
        have h₇ := h₄ (n / 3)
        rw [h₆] at h₃
        omega
      · exfalso
        have h₇ := h₅ (n / 3)
        rw [h₆] at h₃
        omega

import Mathlib

/-- Lemma: 2^n mod 7 depends only on n mod 3. -/
lemma pow_two_mod_7 (n : ℕ) : 2 ^ n % 7 = 
  if n % 3 = 0 then 1 else if n % 3 = 1 then 2 else 4 := by
  have h_period : ∀ k r, r < 3 → 2 ^ (3 * k + r) % 7 = 2 ^ r % 7 := by
    intro k r hr
    rw [show 2 ^ (3 * k + r) = 2 ^ (3 * k) * 2 ^ r by rw [pow_add]]
    rw [show 2 ^ (3 * k) = (2 ^ 3) ^ k by rw [← pow_mul]]
    rw [show 2 ^ 3 = 8 by norm_num]
    have h_pow_8 : ∀ m, 8 ^ m % 7 = 1 := by
      intro m
      induction m with
      | zero => simp
      | succ m ih =>
        rw [pow_succ]
        simp [Nat.mul_mod, ih]
        <;> norm_num
    have h_mul_mod : (8 ^ k * 2 ^ r) % 7 = (8 ^ k % 7 * 2 ^ r % 7) % 7 := by simp [Nat.mul_mod]
    rw [h_mul_mod]
    rw [h_pow_8 k]
    simp [Nat.mul_one, Nat.mod_mod]
  
  have h_decomp : n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3 := by rw [Nat.div_add_mod]
  rw [h_decomp]
  have h_lt : n % 3 < 3 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by norm_num)
  have h_val : 2 ^ (3 * (n / 3) + n % 3) % 7 = 2 ^ (n % 3) % 7 := h_period (n / 3) (n % 3) h_lt
  rw [h_val]
  have h_cases : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by
    exact Nat.lt_three_iff.mpr h_lt
  rcases h_cases with (h | h | h)
  · rw [h]
    norm_num
  · rw [h]
    norm_num
  · rw [h]
    norm_num

/-- IMO 1964 P1 (a): `7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1` iff `3 ∣ n`, for positive `n`. -/
theorem p09_a (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : 7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 ↔ 3 ∣ n := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h₁ : 2 ^ n % 7 = 1 := by
      have h₂ : 7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 := h
      have h₃ : (2 ^ n - 1) % 7 = 0 := Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd h₂
      have h₄ : 2 ^ n ≥ 1 := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by norm_num)
      have h₅ : 2 ^ n % 7 = ((2 ^ n - 1) + 1) % 7 := by
        rw [add_comm]
        rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel h₄]
      rw [h₅]
      simp [Nat.add_mod, h₃]
      <;> norm_num
    have h₂ : n % 3 = 0 := by
      have h₃ : 2 ^ n % 7 = 1 := h₁
      have h₄ : 2 ^ n % 7 = if n % 3 = 0 then 1 else if n % 3 = 1 then 2 else 4 := pow_two_mod_7 n
      rw [h₄] at h₃
      have h_cases : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by
        have h_lt : n % 3 < 3 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by norm_num)
        exact Nat.lt_three_iff.mpr h_lt
      rcases h_cases with (h | h | h)
      · exact h
      · exfalso
        rw [h] at h₃
        norm_num at h₃
      · exfalso
        rw [h] at h₃
        norm_num at h₃
    exact Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h₂
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := h
    have h₁ : 2 ^ (3 * k) % 7 = 1 := by
      have h₂ : (3 * k) % 3 = 0 := by simp [Nat.mul_mod]
      have h₃ : 2 ^ (3 * k) % 7 = if (3 * k) % 3 = 0 then 1 else if (3 * k) % 3 = 1 then 2 else 4 := pow_two_mod_7 (3 * k)
      rw [h₃]
      simp [h₂]
    have h₂ : 7 ∣ 2 ^ (3 * k) - 1 := by
      have h₃ : 2 ^ (3 * k) ≥ 1 := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by norm_num)
      have h₄ : (2 ^ (3 * k) - 1) % 7 = 0 := by
        have h₅ : 2 ^ (3 * k) % 7 = 1 := h₁
        have h₆ : (2 ^ (3 * k) - 1) % 7 = (2 ^ (3 * k) % 7 - 1 % 7) % 7 := by

          <;> omega
        rw [h₆]
        simp [h₅]
        <;> norm_num
      exact Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h₄

/-- IMO 1964 P1 (b): no positive `n` has `7 ∣ 2 ^ n + 1`. -/

/-- Lemma: 2^n mod 7 depends only on n mod 3. -/
lemma pow_two_mod_7 (n : ℕ) : 2 ^ n % 7 = 
  if n % 3 = 0 then 1 else if n % 3 = 1 then 2 else 4 := by
  have h_period : ∀ m, 2 ^ (m + 3) % 7 = 2 ^ m % 7 := by
    intro m
    rw [pow_add, pow_succ, mul_comm]
    simp [Nat.mul_mod, Nat.mul_one]
    <;> norm_num
    <;> omega
  
  have h_decomp : n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3 := by rw [Nat.div_add_mod]
  rw [h_decomp]
  
  have h_step : ∀ k r, 2 ^ (3 * k + r) % 7 = 2 ^ r % 7 := by
    intro k r
    induction k with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k ih =>
      rw [Nat.mul_succ, add_assoc]
      rw [h_period]
      exact ih
  
  have h_r_lt : n % 3 < 3 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by norm_num)
  have h_val : 2 ^ n % 7 = 2 ^ (n % 3) % 7 := by
    rw [h_decomp]
    apply h_step
  rw [h_val]
  
  have h_cases : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by
    have h_lt : n % 3 < 3 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by norm_num)
    have h₀ : n % 3 ≥ 0 := Nat.zero_le _
    omega
  rcases h_cases with (h | h | h)
  · rw [h]
    norm_num
  · rw [h]
    norm_num
  · rw [h]
    norm_num

        norm_num at h₃

  have h_period : ∀ m, 2 ^ (m + 3) % 7 = 2 ^ m % 7 := by
    intro m
    rw [pow_add, pow_succ, mul_comm]
    simp [Nat.mul_mod]
    <;> norm_num
    <;> omega

    have h₀ : n % 3 ≥ 0 := Nat.zero_le _

    rw [pow_add, pow_mul, mul_comm]
    <;> ring_nf

  have h_mod : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
  have h_pow_mod : ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
    rw [← Nat.mod_add_div ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) 7]
    simp [Nat.pow_mod, h_mod]
    <;> norm_num
  rw [Nat.mul_mod]
  simp [h_pow_mod]
